smoke browser scenario enabled: Visits the configured route sweep and retains screenshots plus console, error, and network diagnostics.
auth browser scenario enabled: Exercises browser sign-in, session persistence, sign-out, and protected-route behavior.
performance browser scenario enabled: Measures browser feedback, navigation, heartbeat lag, and mutation load against executable budgets.
auction browser scenario enabled: Places a bid through the real draft-room UI and verifies persisted nomination and bid state.
lineup browser scenario enabled: Moves a bench player through the real lineup screen, then verifies persistence and live cross-tab agreement.
lineup-auto-set browser scenario enabled: Sets today and the remaining season through the real Auto-Set controls, then verifies every generated row.
lineup-locked browser scenario enabled: Attempts a live-game lineup move and verifies locked-player protection in UI and storage.
playoffs browser scenario enabled: Advances a seeded playoff bracket and verifies the champion through the real browser surface.
rookie-draft browser scenario enabled: Lets the visible rookie timer expire and verifies the browser-triggered auto-pick and roster insert.
waiver browser scenario enabled: Submits a no-drop waiver claim through the real modal and verifies the pending claim.
waiver-drop browser scenario enabled: Submits a drop-then-add waiver claim through the real modal and verifies its drop route.
waiver-ir-block browser scenario enabled: Verifies an ineligible IR state blocks waiver submission without persisting a claim.
league-lifecycle browser scenario enabled: Creates and joins a league through the real forms and verifies members, slots, season, and pick bank.
trade-proposal browser scenario enabled: Submits a player trade through the real composer and verifies routed pending items.
trade-accept browser scenario enabled: Accepts a pending player trade through Offers and verifies atomic asset settlement.
trade-terminal browser scenario enabled: Rejects and withdraws pending trades through real controls without moving assets.
trade-future-pick browser scenario enabled: Proposes a future-pick trade through the real composer without moving ownership early.
trade-future-pick-accept browser scenario enabled: Accepts a future-pick trade through Offers and verifies pick ownership settlement.
trade-overflow-accept browser scenario enabled: Accepts over the roster cap without an eager drop, verifies lineup/add locks, then proves a corrective drop is allowed.
trade-post-deadline browser scenario enabled: Attempts a proposal after the deadline and verifies rejection without persisted trade rows.
trade-veto browser scenario enabled: Uses the real veto action and verifies threshold state without moving assets.
trade-multi-team browser scenario enabled: Proposes, edits, and counters routed multi-team assets through responsive browser controls.
